name: War-Awoken Knight's Purge (Weapon Skill)
effects:
Single-target Dark/Fire/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Dark/Fire Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least Lv.0/2 En-Dark/Fire
WS Blue: Lv.2 En-Dark/Fire Stack to user
WS Gold: Surging Power 30% for 6 turns to all allies
